categories.main_business_segments: Leascend Technology primarily operates in the photovoltaic (solar) cell industry, focusing on high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells. The company also engages in mobile communication resale services, enterprise IT services including SaaS, and property leasing through its technology parks. The photovoltaic segment dominates revenue, with significant investments in production capacity expansion.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in HJT solar cell technology, utilizing N-type silicon wafers and advanced manufacturing processes such as 0BB (zero busbar), silver-coated copper paste, and thin wafer technology. It emphasizes high conversion efficiency, low degradation, and cost reduction through innovations like ultra-thin silicon wafers and low silver content pastes. The production involves large G12 wafer sizes and advanced surface passivation techniques to enhance performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Leascend serves photovoltaic module manufacturers domestically and internationally, including major Chinese component companies. Its mobile communication resale business targets individual and enterprise end-users in China. The company also leases properties primarily to biotech, internet, testing, and smart technology firms within its technology parks. The photovoltaic products are sold mainly to industrial customers in the renewable energy sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Sichuan (Meishan) and Jiangsu (Nantong). It actively expands into emerging overseas markets such as the Middle East, Africa, and India, leveraging its technology to capture global demand. Domestic sales constitute the majority of revenue, but export sales have grown significantly, reflecting international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Leascend operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of high-efficiency solar cells. It procures upstream raw materials like silicon wafers and silver paste and supplies downstream to module assemblers. The company also integrates vertically by developing end-market applications and collaborating across the photovoltaic value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes accelerating technological upgrades in HJT solar cells to improve conversion efficiency and reduce production costs. It invests heavily in R&D for ultra-thin wafers, silver-coated copper technology, zero busbar cells, and tandem perovskite solar cells. Strategic initiatives include expanding production capacity, enhancing product quality, and exploring new domestic and international markets, alongside industry chain integration and collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Leascend generates revenue primarily through the direct sale of photovoltaic solar cells and components. It also earns income from mobile communication resale services by purchasing network resources from telecom operators and reselling to end-users. Additional revenue streams include leasing income from technology park properties and enterprise IT service fees, including SaaS offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Leascend is positioned as a leading domestic player in the high-efficiency HJT solar cell segment, competing with other Chinese and global photovoltaic manufacturers advancing N-type cell technologies. Its proprietary technology and early capacity deployment provide a competitive edge. The company is recognized as a key member of industry alliances and clubs promoting advanced solar technologies, aiming to lead in the transition from P-type to N-type solar cells.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Leascend reported revenues of approximately RMB 500.55 million, a 121.79% increase from the previous year, driven mainly by solar cell business growth. However, the company incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 110.32 million due to high production costs and price declines in the photovoltaic market. Total assets stood at about RMB 3.3 billion with ongoing investments in capacity expansion. The company faces profitability challenges but is on a growth trajectory with significant R&D and capital expenditures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Leascend emphasizes its advanced HJT solar cell technology that offers higher conversion efficiency (>26%), lower degradation rates, superior temperature coefficients, and higher bifaciality compared to traditional PERC and TOPCon cells. Its products feature ultra-thin wafers and innovative metallization techniques that reduce costs and carbon footprint. The company’s proprietary technology and patent portfolio enable it to avoid international patent barriers, supporting global market expansion and providing customers with high-performance, cost-effective solar solutions.
